vendor.blurb: Pro line stuck at 3.1, carried by 3-weekly Flash and Omni video; Gemini 4 Pro in stealth.

gemini-4-pro.tagline: Google's comeback card, in stealth on Arena
highlights: Suspected to be testing blind on Arena as 3.8 Flash, codename Barium-B
Leaked DeepSWE v1.1 88.7%, above Astra's 86.9%
Rumored price about 1/5 of Astra's, 2M context
Community says early October launch; not confirmed by Google
gemini-4-pro.notes: All from stealth tests and leaks. One tester says it nears but doesn't reach Opus 5.5; others think the leaked table is fake. Placed at S as a placeholder, to be re-rated at launch.

gemini-3-8-flash.tagline: Google's best live model at Flash prices
highlights: LMArena Text 1492, #10, above Opus 5
DeepSWE v1.1 73.7%, just 0.3 points below Opus 5
AA Intelligence Index 41, output ~239 tokens/s
Third Flash in six weeks; also a cybersecurity edition, 3.8 Flash Cyber
gemini-3-8-flash.notes: low/medium/high levels merged. OSWorld-2.0 59% trails Opus 5's 75.4%; still weak on long-horizon agents.

gemini-3-7-flash.tagline: The coding workhorse replaced in three weeks
highlights: LMArena Text 1488, #15
DeepSWE v1.1 65.3% vs 49.0% for 3.6 Flash
FrontierCode up from 3.6's 34.4% to 43.6%
Just three weeks after 3.6 Flash
gemini-3-7-flash.notes: Same price as 3.8 Flash, now used mostly for compatibility. Context of 1M is inferred from the rest of the series.

gemini-3-6-flash.tagline: The stopgap after 3.5 Pro got cut
highlights: LMArena Text 1482, #20
OSWorld-Verified 83.0% vs 78.4% for 3.5 Flash
About 17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash
MLE-Bench 63.9% vs 49.7% for 3.5 Flash
gemini-3-6-flash.notes: Per SemiAnalysis, Gemini 3.5 Pro was cut after months of delay and 3.6 Flash serves as the bridge to Gemini 4. Google has not confirmed.

gemini-3-5-flash.tagline: I/O 2026 launch model, pricier than successors
highlights: Launched at I/O 2026, kicking off the 3.5 to 3.8 Flash rapid cycle
LMArena Text 1477 (high), #27
OSWorld-Verified 78.4%, DeepSWE 37%
Priced above 3.6 to 3.8 Flash; Google now labels it legacy
gemini-3-5-flash.notes: high and medium levels merged (medium scores 1474). The 1M context is inferred from the same-generation Flash.

gemini-3-5-flash-lite.tagline: 350 tokens a second, a pipeline mini-cannon
highlights: ~350 tokens/s output, Google's fastest model
Terminal-Bench 2.1 54%, up from 31% last gen
AA Intelligence Index 22, about 1/3 the price of 3.8 Flash
LMArena Text 1456
gemini-3-5-flash-lite.notes: Replaces 3.1 Flash-Lite (2026-03); suited to classification, ranking and high-frequency small calls.

gemini-3-1-pro.tagline: Google's last Pro, in preview for seven months
highlights: ARC-AGI-2 77.1% at launch, more than double 3 Pro
SWE-bench Verified 80.6%, GPQA 94.3%
LMArena Text still 1487, #17
AA Intelligence Index only 30, now passed by 3.8 Flash
gemini-3-1-pro.notes: Still gemini-3.1-pro-preview in the API. Gemini 3.5 Pro is rumored canceled; the Pro line waits for Gemini 4.

gemma-4-31b.tagline: The US open-weights bar that fits on one GPU
highlights: Apache 2.0 license, dropping older Gemma's commercial limits
AIME 2026 89.2%, MMLU Pro 85.2%
LMArena Text 1453, AA Intelligence Index 19
Native image and video input, 140+ languages
gemma-4-31b.notes: Reasoning and non-reasoning modes merged (AA for non-reasoning is 14). MTP added 4/16. Kaggle is running a $110K Gemma 4 agent contest.

gemma-4-26b-a4b.tagline: Only 4B active: agents on a laptop
highlights: Just 4B active params; AA measured ~107 tokens/s (non-reasoning)
Launch model for Antigravity SDK local agents, zero token cost
LMArena Text 1438, AA Intelligence Index 17
gemma-4-26b-a4b.notes: Runs fully offline with LiteRT; the workhorse of Google's on-device agent strategy.

gemma-4-12b-unified.tagline: The mid-size slot filled in the Gemma 4 family
highlights: Mid-size model added in June, reasoning and non-reasoning in one
AA Intelligence Index 14 (reasoning), ~114 tokens/s
gemma-4-12b-unified.notes: Could not find official wording on context length or license details.

gemma-4-e4b.tagline: On-device model that translates offline on a Pi
highlights: Runs offline on phones and Raspberry Pi-class devices; text, image and audio input
Official Gemma Translator uses E2B for offline translation on a Pi
AA Intelligence Index: E4B 9, E2B 8
gemma-4-e4b.notes: The two on-device sizes, E4B and E2B, are merged. Built for devices, not comparable with frontier models.

nano-banana-2.tagline: Google's image workhorse, now behind GPT Image
highlights: LMArena text-to-image 1261, #9, Google's highest
LMArena image edit 1388, #12
API codename gemini-3.1-flash-image, up to 4K output
Widely integrated: Runway, Flow, Gemini app and more
nano-banana-2.notes: The text-to-image leader is gpt-image-2.5 (1424), a gap of about 160 points. Traces of Nano Banana 2.1 have appeared in Flow.

nano-banana-pro.tagline: The 4K pro tier, still Google's best editor
highlights: LMArena image edit 1390 (2K), #9, Google's highest
LMArena text-to-image 1247 (2K), #14
Built on Gemini 3 Pro; known for precise text rendering and world knowledge
nano-banana-pro.notes: API codename gemini-3-pro-image, now GA. Could not find the current official per-image price, so it is left blank.

nano-banana-2-lite.tagline: Four seconds an image, pennies each
highlights: Text-to-image in ~4 seconds, about 2.7x faster than Nano Banana 2
LMArena text-to-image 1250, #13, only 11 points below NB2
Google recommends it as the replacement for the original Nano Banana
nano-banana-2-lite.notes: API codename gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image. Live in consumer products including Search AI Mode, Photos and NotebookLM.

nano-banana-2-1.tagline: The next image model spotted in Flow's code
highlights: TestingCatalog found NB 2.1 strings in a Flow build
Originally referenced as Nano Banana 2.5 Flash; the rename reads like a point update
Some guess it ships the same week as Gemini 4 Pro
nano-banana-2-1.notes: Code traces only, no hands-on tests yet. Score is a placeholder based on Nano Banana 2, to be re-rated at launch.

nano-banana.tagline: The original that sparked the banana-edit craze
highlights: The first Gemini 2.5 Flash Image, famous for character-consistent edits
LMArena text-to-image #32 (1150), image edit #28 (1293)
nano-banana.notes: Google now suggests migrating to Nano Banana 2 Lite; the API lists it under the access-restricted 2.5 series.

imagen-4.tagline: The pure-diffusion line Nano Banana replaced
highlights: Imagen 4 Ultra: LMArena text-to-image 1148, #34
Gemini API has shut down imagen-4.0-generate
imagen-4.notes: Standard, Ultra and Fast merged. Google image generation has moved fully to Gemini-native images (Nano Banana); this entry is a historical reference only.

highlights: LMArena text-to-video 1516, #1
LMArena image-to-video 1488, #2, behind only MiniMax H3
Adds first/last-frame control and 40-second scene extension; upscales to 4K
Adobe, Figma and Runway have integrated it into workflows
gemini-omni-1-1-flash.notes: API is still in preview. Google Vids has fully switched to it, though one Chinese blogger found Vids output underwhelming.

highlights: Launched at I/O 2026; API public beta 6/30
#1 on the AA text-to-video with audio board, Elo 1233
LMArena text-to-video #2 (1513), image-to-video #6
Free to use in YouTube Shorts
gemini-omni-flash.notes: The first API release lacked audio references and scene extension; 1.1 added both.

bench.AA Text-to-Video（带音频）: #1, tied within CI with Wan 3.0 (1229) and H3 Max (1227)

highlights: LMArena text-to-video 1364, #12
LMArena image-to-video 1398, #13
#14 on the AA text-to-video with audio board, Elo 1088
Still being integrated by Runway, Flow and other major platforms
veo-3-1.notes: Veo 3.1 and Fast merged (Fast scores 1362 on LMArena). The 2025-10 launch month is from memory, not checked on an official page.

veo-3-1-lite.tagline: Five cents a second, the bulk-output tier
highlights: Less than half the price of Veo 3.1 Fast, at the same speed
720p/1080p, landscape and portrait, 4/6/8 seconds
Native audio included
veo-3-1-lite.notes: No standalone arena ranking found; tier is estimated from price and positioning.

genie-3.tagline: One sentence, a real-time world to walk into
highlights: First general-purpose real-time interactive world model, navigable at 24fps
Opened to Ultra users as Project Genie on 2026-01-29
Connected to Street View at I/O 2026 to simulate real places
Waymo derived a driving simulation world model from it
genie-3.notes: World models have no leaderboard comparable to video generation; tier reflects uniqueness and influence. No reliable news on Genie 4 found.
